case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Multiple guests praised the hotel's excellent location, friendly staff, cleanliness, attractive decor and comfortable beds; several reviews also noted good breakfasts and pleasant corridors and scent. Reported negatives included noise from the metro, a few very small showers or rooms, missing bathroom toiletries (no shampoo/conditioner reported), an air-conditioning unit turning off at night, and instances where breakfast was not included.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Verify water outages, inspect plumbing/hot-water, audit amenities, schedule assessment and remediation if unclear.
Check in-room HVAC, ensure prompt maintenance response, log incidents, review noise mitigation, commission inspection if unclear.
Review breakfast operations; reconcile booking claims with on-site practice; review guest-facing pricing and bundled-extras messaging.

priorities.area: Guest comfort: nighttime noise & room climate control
priorities.recommendation: Brief front-desk to offer quiet rooms/earplugs; maintenance inspect/log/escalate HVAC; where-feasible test noise-exposure to guide allocation.

priorities.area: Consistency of in‑room toiletries and basic supplies
priorities.recommendation: Verify toiletries checklist, supervisory-spot-checks, stock logs; train staff to confirm placement pre-checkout and log requests.

priorities.area: Room product variability (size of rooms / small shower boxes)
priorities.recommendation: Update room descriptions/photos and floorplans, and review feasibility and costs of bathroom modifications.
